REPUBLIC OF KENYA
IN THE HIGH COURT OF KENYA AT MACHAKOS
CIVIL APPEAL NO. E007 OF 2026
BETWEEN
DANIEL KYALO MUTISO ........ APPELLANT
AND
THE COUNCIL, INSURANCE INSTITUTE OF KENYA ........ RESPONDENT
JUDGMENT
Coram: Hon. Justice M. W. Njagi-Okumu
Delivered on 2nd October 2026
1. The Appellant, an insurance agent, appeals against the decision of the Respondent cancelling his registration and withdrawing his practising certificate for alleged misappropriation of premiums collected from three clients.
2. The issue of practising certificates is provided for in section 22 of the Insurance Professionals Act, 2021, and cancellation of registration in section 28 of that Act.
3. The Appellant was not given the complaint or the documents relied on before the hearing before the Disciplinary Committee, and the hearing proceeded in his absence on a date of which he had been given 2 days' notice.
4. Article 50(1) of the Constitution guarantees the right to have a dispute decided in a fair hearing. A hearing on 2 days' notice, without disclosure of the case to be met, is not a fair hearing.
5. The appeal is allowed. The cancellation is set aside and the complaint is remitted to a differently constituted Disciplinary Committee, which shall hear it within 45 days after supplying the Appellant with all documents relied on.
6. The Respondent shall pay the costs of the appeal.
M. W. NJAGI-OKUMU
JUDGE
